sloka: साधुर्वा यदिवा ऽसाधुः परैरेष समर्पितः ।ब्रुवन् परार्थं परवान् न दूतो वधमर्हति ।। ५.५२.१९।।।।
transliteration: sādhurvā yadivā 'sādhuḥ paraireṣa samarpitaḥ ।bruvan parārthaṁ paravān na dūto vadhamarhati ।। 5.52.19।।।।

translations.english: "I do not see any use in killing this monkey. Pronounce punishment on those who have sent this vanara.
